summary: Sangrix Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting outcomes of an extraordinary general meeting held November 3, 2026 in Singapore, the local equivalent of a US special shareholder meeting. Holders approved an 8-for-1 share consolidation effective November 13, 2026, cutting Class A and B shares to US$0.0024 par, plus conforming amended articles and an adjournment resolution. Quorum represented 0.88% of Class A and 100% of Class B, about 35.71% of voting power, reflecting dual-class 20-vote Class B control. All proposals passed; no deal terms, advisors or consideration involved.
